_comment: Maps Azure Policy definition IDs and Defender for Cloud rule IDs to STIG control identifiers. Add or extend entries to cover additional STIG controls.

V-220700.title: Windows 10 must use multifactor authentication for local and network access.
V-220700.checkText: Verify multifactor authentication (MFA) is required for interactive logons. If only password-based authentication is used, this is a finding.
V-220700.fixText: Enable Windows Hello for Business or configure smart card requirements via Group Policy.
V-220700.notes: Covered by Azure AD Conditional Access policy 'Require MFA for all users' when enforced at the subscription level.

V-220701.title: Windows 10 security event log size must be configured to 32768 KB or greater.
V-220701.checkText: Check: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\EventLog\Security\MaxSize. Must be >= 0x8000 (32768). If absent or smaller, this is a finding.
V-220701.fixText: Configure via GPO: Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Event Log > Maximum security log size = 32768 or greater.
V-220701.notes: Also verifiable via Azure Policy guest configuration.

V-220702.title: Windows 10 domain-joined systems must have a Trusted Platform Module (TPM) enabled.
V-220702.checkText: Verify TPM is enabled in device firmware (UEFI) and readable via Get-Tpm in PowerShell. If TpmPresent is False or TpmReady is False, this is a finding.
V-220702.fixText: Enable TPM in UEFI/BIOS firmware settings. For virtual machines, ensure vTPM is enabled in Hyper-V or Azure VM configuration.
V-220702.notes: Azure VMs support vTPM when Generation 2 and Trusted Launch is enabled.

V-220703.title: Windows 10 must employ automated mechanisms for account management.
V-220703.checkText: Verify Active Directory or Azure AD is used for account management. Local-only accounts for interactive use are a finding.
V-220703.fixText: Join machines to Azure AD or hybrid join with on-premises AD. Disable or remove extraneous local administrator accounts.
V-220703.notes: Maps to 'Audit virtual machines not using managed disks' as an indicator of unmanaged resources.

V-220704.title: Windows 10 must have an anti-virus solution installed.
V-220704.checkText: Verify Microsoft Defender Antivirus is enabled and signatures are current. If the service is disabled or signatures are > 7 days old, this is a finding.
V-220704.fixText: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus and configure automatic signature updates. Use Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) for endpoint protection.
V-220704.notes: Directly surfaced by Defender for Cloud 'Endpoint protection issues should be resolved on your machines' recommendation.

meta.source: DISA STIG for Microsoft Windows 10 V2R8
meta.notes: This mapping is illustrative. Validate each policy definition ID against your Azure environment and the authoritative STIG benchmark before use in production.
